target.title: refactor(qa): drive Matrix lifecycle through channel drivers
target.body:
Closes #101054

## What Problem This Solves

Matrix lifecycle proof needs to follow the same channel-driver selection seam as the rest of QA Lab. Selecting `live:matrix` should create the existing Matrix live transport, which privately owns Tuwunel; selecting `crabline:matrix` should create Crabline through the same transport-adapter registry.

## Why This Change Was Made

This PR now puts the lifecycle foundation at the QA Lab transport-adapter boundary:

1. `createQaChannelDriverLifecycle()` owns generic start, idempotent start, restart, stop, and resume control around `createQaTransportAdapter()`.
2. The selected driver is the only switch. `live:matrix` resolves the registered Matrix live adapter; `crabline:matrix` resolves the built-in Crabline adapter.
3. Live adapter discovery is lazy, so exporting the lifecycle contract does not eagerly pull the live transport CLI graph into the default QA runtime entry.
4. One parameterized live test runs the same five scenarios through both real drivers.
5. The previous `qa-matrix` lifecycle helpers and private test API are removed. The final PR diff has no `qa-matrix` files; full plugin migration/removal remains separate follow-up work.

This is a test/runtime-control seam inside QA Lab, not an end-user Matrix runtime or configuration surface. It adds no environment variable and no Matrix-plugin policy.

## User Impact

No end-user behavior or configuration changes. Maintainers get one channel-driver lifecycle contract and real parity proof for Tuwunel-backed live Matrix and Crabline without intertwining the foundation with the `qa-matrix` plugin.

The Matrix plugin bundle does not grow: the final diff contains no `extensions/qa-matrix/**` changes. QA Lab's runtime entry gains only the lifecycle export; channel-driver factory discovery remains a lazy dynamic import.

## Evidence

Exact pushed head: `395b864d203`.

Blacksmith Testbox `tbx_01kwx3qb2wvp9x0mv9v3way3h1` (`golden-crab`):

- `OPENCLAW_BUILD_PRIVATE_QA=1 corepack pnpm build` passed.
- `corepack pnpm test extensions/qa-lab/src/channel-driver-lifecycle.test.ts` passed 2/2 tests.
- `node scripts/test-live.mjs -- extensions/qa-lab/src/matrix-channel-driver.lifecycle.live.test.ts` passed both real drivers and all five lifecycle scenarios.
- `corepack pnpm tsgo:extensions` passed.
- `corepack pnpm tsgo:extensions:test` passed.
- Targeted extension oxlint passed with 0 warnings and 0 errors.
- `git diff --check` passed.

Fresh canonical autoreview thread `019f3a53-cf96-7f22-bd96-219e9a99b1d1` reported no accepted/actionable findings and judged the patch correct.

Developed with AI assistance. A sanitized agent transcript is available but is not included without explicit approval.
